:::{#def-covariate-vector}
#### Covariate vector of a linear model

Consider a model whose mean is a linear combination
of $p$ terms $t_1(x), \ldots, t_p(x)$ of the covariate value,
such as $1$, $x$ and $x^2$.
The **covariate vector** $\vxi$ of observation $i$
is the column of its terms:

$$
\vxi \eqdef \paren{t_1(x_i), \ldots, t_p(x_i)}\tp{}.
$$ {#eq-covariate-vector}

:::
